_comment: Shared by pytest (tests/test_a_listen_scene_break_rule_is_shared.py), vitest (ui/src/listen/textScript.test.ts) and the JVM test (SceneBreakTest.kt): the scene-break line rule of abook/text_processing.py (is_scene_break_line, with its `alone` flag) and its read-aloud port (textScript.ts splitParagraphs / sceneBreakGaps, Paragraphs.kt). `alone` = the line is a whole paragraph (blank lines around it, one line in the paragraph); a file with no blank line at all is ONE paragraph there. Change one side, change the others and this file.

paragraphs.name: an ellipsis, a quote mark or a chapter heading is not a scene break
a lone star or dash that is a whole paragraph is a scene break
a lone star inside a multi-line paragraph is ordinary text
a lone em dash may be a silent line of dialogue
in a file with no blank line (one paragraph for the Python rule) a lone star line is ordinary, a full separator is not
